title: Complete Frontend Experience: Base Template, CRUD Pages, Navigation & Static Assets
description:
[FRONTEND EXPERIENCE TIER]
Builds the complete server-rendered UI layer: base template with Bootstrap 5.3 CDN, navigation partial, messages partial, pagination partial, and all CRUD-specific templates. Includes responsive styling, interactive elements with visual feedback, and JavaScript enhancements for delete confirmation.

[SCREEN STORY - Base Template & Navigation]
The user loads any page and sees a consistent Bootstrap 5.3-styled layout. The base.html template provides: HTML5 structure, viewport meta, Bootstrap CSS CDN (with local fallback comment), custom.css link, navbar partial inclusion, messages partial for Django flashes, main content block, Bootstrap JS bundle, and main.js. The _navbar.html partial shows "Django Todo App" brand and links to: Todo List (active when on list page), Add New Todo. Navigation uses Bootstrap navbar with collapse for mobile.

[SCREEN STORY - Todo List Page]
The user arrives at /todos/ (todo-list). They see: page header "My Todos" with count badge, search input with "Search todos..." placeholder (filters on type via form submit), "Add New Todo" button linking to todo-create. Below is a Bootstrap table with columns: Status (checkbox icon + text), Title (clickable), Created, Actions. Each row shows: status badge (Complete/Incomplete with color coding), title link to todo-detail, formatted date, action buttons (Edit → todo-update, Toggle → POST to todo-toggle, Delete → triggers confirmation modal). Pagination controls at bottom (10 per page) with preserved search state. Empty state shows "No todos yet" with create link.

[SCREEN STORY - Todo Detail Page]
The user clicks a title from list and arrives at /todos/{id}/ (todo-detail). They see: breadcrumb (Todos > Detail), card with title header, status badge prominently displayed, created/updated timestamps, action buttons (Edit, Toggle Status, Delete with confirmation), and "Back to List" link.

[SCREEN STORY - Create/Edit Form Page]
The user clicks "Add New Todo" or "Edit" and arrives at todo-create or todo-update. They see: card with form header ("Create Todo" or "Edit Todo"), ModelForm rendered with Bootstrap form controls, title input with validation error display, CSRF token, submit button (primary), and cancel link back to todo-list. On validation error, inline errors appear below field. On success, redirect to list with flash message.

[SCREEN STORY - Delete Confirmation]
The user clicks Delete on list or detail. A Bootstrap modal appears with todo title, "Delete" confirm button (POST to todo-delete), and Cancel. JavaScript in main.js handles modal trigger and focus management.

[SCREEN CONNECTIVITY]
- Navbar "Todo List" → /todos/ (todo-list)
- Navbar "Add New Todo" → /todos/create/ (todo-create)
- List table title → /todos/{id}/ (todo-detail)
- List "Edit" button → /todos/{id}/edit/ (todo-update)
- List "Delete" button → triggers modal, confirms → POST /todos/{id}/delete/ (todo-delete)
- List "Toggle" button → POST /todos/{id}/toggle/ (todo-toggle), returns to list
- Detail "Edit" → todo-update
- Detail "Delete" → modal → todo-delete
- Detail "Back to List" → todo-list
- All forms: Cancel → todo-list

[MOCK DATA SPECIFICATION]
Not applicable - server-rendered with real database. Templates use {{ todo.title }}, {{ todo.is_completed }}, {{ todo.created_at|date:"F d, Y" }}, etc.

[FILE OWNERSHIP]
This agent owns: templates/, static/css/, static/js/
This agent must create:
  - templates/base.html (Bootstrap 5.3 CDN, blocks: title, content, extra_css, extra_js)
  - templates/partials/_navbar.html (responsive nav with brand and links)
  - templates/partials/_messages.html (Django messages framework display with Bootstrap alert classes)
  - templates/partials/_pagination.html (Bootstrap pagination with preserved query params)
  - templates/todos/todo_list.html (search form, table with status badges, action buttons, empty state)
  - templates/todos/todo_detail.html (card layout, metadata, action buttons, back link)
  - templates/todos/todo_form.html (create/edit shared form, CSRF, validation errors)
  - templates/todos/todo_confirm_delete.html (or modal implementation in list/detail)
  - static/css/custom.css (custom overrides, status badge colors, spacing utilities)
  - static/js/main.js (delete confirmation modal handling, form validation enhancement)
This agent must IMPORT from: apps/todos/ (URL names via {% url %}), Django staticfiles
This agent must NOT modify: apps/todos/views.py logic, config/settings/, but may reference URL names defined there
subtasks: Create base.html with Bootstrap 5.3 CDN, viewport meta, blocks for title/content/extra_css/extra_js, and partial includes
Create _navbar.html partial with responsive Bootstrap navbar, brand, and navigation links to todo-list and todo-create
Create _messages.html partial iterating Django messages with Bootstrap alert-dismissible styling
Create _pagination.html partial with Bootstrap pagination component and query param preservation for search/filter
Create todo_list.html with search form, todo count, Add New Todo button, responsive table with status badges, action buttons (Edit, Toggle, Delete), and empty state
Create todo_detail.html with card layout, status badge, timestamps, action buttons (Edit, Toggle, Delete), and Back to List link
Create todo_form.html shared for create/edit with Bootstrap form controls, CSRF token, title field with error display, submit and cancel buttons
Create todo_confirm_delete.html or implement modal-based confirmation in list/detail with POST form
Create custom.css with status badge colors (.badge-complete, .badge-incomplete), spacing utilities, responsive table styles
Create main.js with delete confirmation modal trigger, form validation enhancement, and Bootstrap initialization
Verify all templates use {% csrf_token %} on POST forms; verify no |safe filter on user data; test responsive layout at mobile breakpoint
